scope: Roadmap6 second component only: initial coarse/fine scheduling shared by IMLS-SLAM and opt-in SuMa; per-method residuals/correspondences/stopping stay local. Not a shared numerical aligner. No degeneracy remap combination. Near-range and NCLT remain open.
selection: One registration and ten coarse iterations come from existing IMLS-SLAM04 calibration; the distance multiplier5 comes from coarse_r1.0 / paper_r0.20, also the existing bandwidth ratio. SuMa has gate2m so the new coarse gate is10m; SuMa retains its Huber factor, normal gate and projective associations, not IMLS residuals/bandwidth. No SuMa tuning/sweep. Historical SuMa00-10 and previous remap negatives already known; no held-out claim.
audit_scope: Stored best-RPE full-sequence cells for the two consumers of the new startup helper,22 cells. Existing common loaders and other paper cores unchanged; fixture/CTest coverage for those. Not a new whole-zoo audit.
controls: Fresh SuMa raw defaults reused from audit when arguments match; separate fresh raw control01/02. Frozen prechange full04 for both methods, and frozen replay of any later drifted audit cell.
suma_behavior: Coarse frame-to-model ICP starts from the usual initial guess; fine starts from coarse output. Shared schedule counts registrations starting1 after map-initialization scan0. Official fallback still uses original T0 and unchanged gates; fine stats retain their previous meaning; coarse stats/count are separate. Defaults coarse_frames0, remap0.
timing_scope: Concurrent independent processes with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1; no speed claim.
publication: Nested experimental evidence only. Historical aggregate hashes and README/HTML/Table6/paper metadata bytes must remain unchanged. Automatic single-variant adoption labels are not a paired-control recommendation.
